page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. In the right margin, beside the first paragraph, one marginal note. Below the text, a woodcut ornament (not text).

main_text.p: illa nubes est, ex qua siccus ille halitus eliditur: tonitru non amplius ista, sed illa quæ icta est: quia sonitus ille quicquid Vulgus dicat, de sententia Philosophi, non elisione fit, sed ictu, cum elisus ille halitus sive Spiritus in aliam Lib.1.Meteor.cap.8 nubem densam incidit: quo ictu tum sonus editur, tum Spiritus accenditur: quæ accensio tonitrui consectarium quoddam est.
Maris denique & salsæ illius aquæ subiectum concretum corpus est, quod è potiore parte elementi aquæ, & sicco illo, qui unà cum pluvia deorsum perpetuo fertur, halitu, constat.

Concludimus ergo, primum & adæquatum Meteorologicarum affectionum subiectum imperfectè mixtum corpus, quâ tale est, esse, idque ex uno è quatuor elementis & alterutro halitu concretum corpus esse: quod quatuor præcipuas sub se species comprehendit, concretionem è sicco illo halitu & elemento ignis, ex aere & alterutro halitu, è terra & alterutro halitu, ex aqua & halitu sicco[?],

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is decorative and not transcribed. The first word of the page, printed "illa" with a long-s-like initial, is read as "illa". The page number "9" at the head is uncertain and marked [?]. The sicco at the end of the last line has a doubtful final abbreviation mark, marked [?]. The marginal note is printed across two lines ("Lib.1.Me-" / "teor.cap.8") and is given here as one hyphenated note. Printing errors, such as "species"-type long-s forms, have been normalised to plain s; no other changes were made to the spelling.
